WITH raw AS (
 SELECT symbol, date, close FROM public.daily_bars WHERE symbol IN ('159509','159529','159934','159957','159981','159985','161226','164824','501018','511380','512800','513100','513290','513530') AND date BETWEEN DATE '2019-01-01' AND DATE '2026-11-12' AND close > 0
), r AS (SELECT symbol,date,close,LN(close/LAG(close,1) OVER w) AS r1,LN(close/LAG(close,5) OVER w) AS r5,LN(close/LAG(close,20) OVER w) AS r20 FROM raw WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY date)),
v AS (SELECT symbol,date,r1,r5,r20,STDDEV_SAMP(r1) OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS vol20,COUNT(r1) OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS n20,STDDEV_SAMP(r1) OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 59 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS vol60,COUNT(r1) OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 59 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS n60 FROM r),
daily AS (SELECT date,SUM(CASE WHEN r20>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::float/NULLIF(COUNT(r20),0) AS breadth20,PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY vol20) FILTER (WHERE n20=20) AS median_vol20,
SUM(CASE WHEN n20=20 AND n60=60 AND vol20>vol60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::float/NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE n20=20 AND n60=60),0) AS vol_expand,
SUM(CASE WHEN r5< LN(0.97) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::float/NULLIF(COUNT(r5),0) AS down5,
COUNT(r20) AS n_breadth,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE n20=20 AND n60=60) AS n_vol
FROM v WHERE date>=DATE '2021-01-01' GROUP BY date)
SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('d',TO_CHAR(date,'YYYYMMDD'),'breadth20',breadth20,'medianVol20',median_vol20,'volExpand',vol_expand,'down5',down5,'nBreadth',n_breadth,'nVol',n_vol) ORDER BY date) AS state FROM daily;
definition: 14 retrospectively fixed ETF inputs; indicators only use historical and same-day closes
